texts.preamble: Gautambhai Maghjibhai Patel vs State Of Gujarat & on 15 April, 2015 Author: N.V.Anjaria Bench: N.V.Anjaria R/Cr.Ra/173/2015 Order
texts.facts: The report of the Public Analyst, as submitted by learned advocate for the applicant, indicated the offence of misbranding under section 16(1) Gautambhai Maghjibhai Patel vs State Of Gujarat & on 15 April, 2015 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/94948708/ 1 (a)(i) as well as offence punishable under section 16(1)(a)(ii) of the R/CR.RA/173/2015 ORDER Act. It appears that the sanction was obtained in respect of offence under section 16(1)(a)(i). Under the impugned judgment, conviction and sentence was recorded for the offence under the said section i.e. under section 16(1)(a)(i) of the Act. The contention coming forth from the learned advocate for the applicant is that since the sanction was not obtained with reference to the offence under 16(1)(a)(ii) of the Act, the entire trial was vitiated.
